description: Crime Prevention looks at why laws exist and how communities keep people safe: crime in your area, security surveys, retail crime, reporting crime and abuse, peer pressure, substance use, online safety, and careers in public safety.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Crime and the law
requirements.summary: Why criminal laws exist, types of crime, why people commit crimes, and what crime prevention means.

requirements.title: Who prevents crime
requirements.summary: How citizens, schools and neighborhood or youth groups help prevent crime.

requirements.title: Crime in your community
requirements.summary: Researching news coverage of several different kinds of crime.

requirements.title: Security survey and lesson
requirements.summary: How design and community groups deter crime, a home or building security survey, and teaching a lesson.

requirements.title: Retail crime
requirements.summary: The effects of shoplifting and employee theft, and how stores prevent them.

requirements.title: Reporting crime and staying safe
requirements.summary: When and how to report crimes, warning signs of abuse, and personal safety rules.

requirements.title: Peers and crime
requirements.summary: Peer pressure, bullying, hazing and gangs.

requirements.title: Substance use and crime
requirements.summary: Legal and health consequences of substances, their link to crime, and where to get help.

requirements.title: Online crime
requirements.summary: Scams, identity theft, online security, and how bullying and sharing images can become crimes.

requirements.title: Interview
requirements.summary: Interviewing a law enforcement officer or other public servant about crime prevention.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: Careers in crime prevention and researching one of them.
